title: Vermont Rebate Calculator 2026: Efficiency Vermont Heat Pump, Water Heater and Weatherization
h1: Vermont Rebate Calculator 2026: What Efficiency Vermont Pays
desc: Free Vermont rebate calculator. Efficiency Vermont heat pump, heat pump water heater and weatherization rebates, with income-based bonuses and the official source for every amount.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Vermont rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: Efficiency Vermont pays up to $475 for a ductless heat pump and up to $2,200 for a ducted one, $600 for a heat pump water heater, and 75% of weatherization costs back, up to $3,000. Low- and moderate-income households get bonuses on all three, and weatherization goes up to $7,000.
faq: How much is the Vermont heat pump rebate in 2026?

Efficiency Vermont pays up to $475 on a ductless heat pump and up to $2,200 on a ducted one, plus $600 more for integrated controls with a ductless system. Low- and moderate-income households get a $200 to $2,200 bonus, depending on utility and income.
Do Green Mountain Power customers get extra?

Green Mountain Power lists a $2,000 heat pump rebate for customers at or below 80% of area median income, paid on top of the Efficiency Vermont rebate. We have not re-confirmed it recently, so we do not add it to your total.
How much does Efficiency Vermont pay for weatherization?

75% of the project cost back, up to $3,000, or up to $7,000 for low- and moderate-income households. You need an Efficiency Excellence Network contractor and a blower-door test showing at least 10% less air leakage.
Is the federal tax credit still available?
No. The 25C and 25D credits ended for spending after December 31, 2025.
